modmenu.summaryTranslation.door_light_bl: Closed doors block light like a solid block.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.door_ligh: Closed doors block light like a solid block; open doors let it through. Install on both client and server. Configurable via JSON file, with an optional Mod Menu + YACL screen.
config.door_light_blocker.title: Door Light Blocker
config.door_light_blocker.live: Changes apply the next time a door is opened or closed. On a multiplayer server, restart the game and the server, and use the same values on both.
config.door_light_blocker.restart: You are connected to a server: changes are saved but apply after restarting the game and the server. Use the same values on both.
config.door_light_blocker.default.name: Default closed door light block
config.door_light_blocker.default.descri: Light blocked by a closed door when neither its door nor its group has an override. 0 keeps the vanilla value, 15 blocks all light.
config.door_light_blocker.group.wooden.d: Vanilla wood-type doors: oak, spruce, birch, acacia, cherry, jungle, dark oak, pale oak, mangrove, bamboo, crimson and warped. Inherit uses the general value.
config.door_light_blocker.group.copper.d: All copper doors, including waxed and oxidized variants. Inherit uses the general value.
config.door_light_blocker.group.iron.des: The iron door. Inherit uses the general value.
config.door_light_blocker.group.other.de: Doors added by other mods whose type is not one of the groups above. Inherit uses the general value.
config.door_light_blocker.doors.group.de: An override beats the group value. Inherit uses the group value, or the general value if the group is also inherited.
config.door_light_blocker.door.descripti: Light blocked when this door is closed. 0 keeps the vanilla value; Inherit uses the group value.
